project.name: Proven
project.summary: A pull-request reviewer whose every finding carries evidence a reader can check again: a test that fails on the change, or a query through Zetaris and the rows it returned.

track: The Agent That Can Explain Why

builders.name: Marcin "Wato" Marzec
builders.role: owner: decides and merges; writes no code

zetaris.how: The evidence layer: every evidence source (OSV, CISA KEV, FIRST EPSS, the repository's history) is a table behind Zetaris, and a finding about a dependency is proved by one SQL query and the rows it returned.

meterless.how: H-MEM remembers findings refuted in earlier reviews and maintainers' rulings; the World Model holds each review's claims, evidence, refutations and verdicts. Built in Go and checked with Meterless's conformance suites. Every model call goes through Meterless Nightshift.

cursor.how: Cursor agents write the product code, each from a written order, in its own copy of the repository; their reports and the reviews of their work are in fleet/.

nvidia.how: Nemotron is the default first reviewer and the Skeptic that tries to refute each finding; Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety guards every prompt and answer.

pre_existing.name: Saphan Studio
pre_existing.what: The platform that runs the agent fleet building Proven: orders, runs, reviews and their record. A tool used to build, not part of the product.

pre_existing.name: Test corpus
pre_existing.what: 21 test cases from 28 real review disagreements, with their code, declared as prior art.
